_help: Lines shown under the newsletter header. Each entry: key (unique, letters/numbers/hyphens, never reused), from (first issue date it can appear, YYYY-MM-DD), optional until (last date), text, link. Shown in one issue that is sent live, then retired automatically.

entries.text: This newsletter comes from website@thelenches.org.uk. To make sure it keeps reaching your inbox, please add that address to your contacts.

New on the website: a fresh look, events and news from around the Lenches updated daily, church service times with links to each Sunday's Bible readings, and your bin days. Have a look at thelenches.org.uk.

New on the website: a new home page, a Notices page for notices and news from around the villages, and a Roads page with a map of closures and roadworks and a slider to see what's on any day in the next 8 weeks.
